newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe tumbles as debt deal delayed.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe tumbles as debt deal delayed.

text.p: The shares of Polish construction firm Espebepe SA plunged 9.4 percent to 6.25 zlotys after a decision on its possible debt write-off deal was postponed until April 14, traders said.
Espebepe did not trade after the price fixing due to excess supply.

"Extended uncertainty is a very negative signal in this case as many investors speculated expecting a positive solution," one trader said. He added the stock could extend its fall in the next few sessions.

Espebepe's creditors met on Friday to decide on whether to offer the company a debt-relief programme to save it from bankruptcy danger, but the meeting was regarded as non-valid, because of procedural reasons and moved to April 14.
